messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: knitr v1.2
parts:
Hi,

I have just released knitr v1.2 to CRAN:
http://cran.r-project.org/package=knitr The source package is there
now; Windows/Mac binaries are coming in the next few days, but you can
also install.packages('knitr', repos='http://cran.r-project.org',
type='source')

New features and bug fixes are in NEWS:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/NEWS.md

A special note to package developers: since R 3.0.0 has come,
non-Sweave vignettes are officially supported now. Please remember to
clean up your inst/doc/ or vignette/ directory. For example, if you
were using Makefile to compile vignettes, this Makefile can be removed
now. To use knitr to build vignettes, please follow these three simple
steps: http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/vignette/ Please let me know if
you run into any problems.

Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
